propositions: Six git call sites across three modules currently lack explicit network timeouts and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
gerrit_client.clone_change_ref has five unbounded subprocess.run calls including two network-capable fetches, and TimeoutExpired escapes the token-redaction handler exposing credentials
workspace._git passes no timeout to subprocess.run, leaving all five git calls in the module unbounded including two network fetches
_ref_lock.py is already fully bounded with timeout as a required parameter; no edit needed
A 300-second timeout is appropriate for cold-clone operations in both modules, matching the precedent of bug 747f rather than the 30-second store profile
TimeoutExpired exceptions must be caught and converted to module-specific exceptions (GerritError, WorkspaceError) naming the operation and bound, with credentials scrubbed from error messages
